title: ROMEO-HYDRA v0.2.0 — Information Folding Topology (Structure-Before-Specificity)
description:
Release that elevates information folding as a base principle of computer topology inside ROMEO-HYDRA.

Principle: any digital object induces a space. Stable information lives in structural invariants (components, identity cycles, critical order). High-entropy detail is scaffold and can be discarded or regenerated under a rate budget. Encoding invariants is folding; reconstruction is unfolding.

Metaphor: the cell packs ~2 m of DNA into a nucleus smaller than 0.5 mm — not by deleting sequence, but by hierarchical folding that preserves function. The same idea applied to files, documents, ledgers and media: keep what must persist, fold away what does not.

Includes:
- romeo.topology.fold (fold_bytes, fold_text, fold_file)
- romeo.tools.video (YC-ready offline compress as a media instance of the same principle)
- docs/TOPOLOGY.md
- Offline / Termux aarch64 compatible APIs
- Continuity with prior DOIs (concept 10.5281/zenodo.21744014)
